nodes.summary: For natural numbers $n$ and $m$ and a finite set $S$ of elements of the free group on $x_0, \dots, x_{m-1}$, this is the group with generators $x_0, \dots, x_{m-1}$ and relators $S$ together with $w^n$ for every element $w$ of the free group: the group finitely presented by $S$ in the Burnside variety $\mathfrak{B}_n$ of groups of exponent $n$.
nodes.title: Groups finitely presented in a Burnside variety

nodes.summary: There is $n_0$ such that for every odd $n \ge n_0$, every group of exponent $n$ given by generators $x_0, x_1, \dots$ and a recursively enumerable set of relators embeds in a group finitely presented in the Burnside variety $\mathfrak{B}_n$: a group with generators $x_0, \dots, x_{m-1}$ for some $m$ whose relators are a finite set $S$ together with $w^n$ for every word $w$.
nodes.title: Higman embedding theorem for Burnside varieties

nodes.summary: There is $n_0$ such that for every odd $n \ge n_0$ the following holds. Let $G$ be a group given by generators $x_0, x_1, \dots$ and a recursively enumerable set of relators, and suppose that $g^n = 1$ for every $g \in G$.
